info.title: Planta's Public APIs
info.description: APIs for a user's plants and support for completing actions

post.description: Exchange OTP for a token and refresh token.

200.description: Token and refresh token used for API calls.

message.example: You are not authorized to make this request

415.description: Request body is not sent as application/json

get.description: Returns information about added plants. The API is paginated and returns up to 50 plants per call.

message.example: You are not authorized to make this request

get.description: Get information about the added plant.

200.description: Returns plant information about a specific added plant.

message.example: You are not authorized to make this request

post.description: Completes an action of the specified action type.

actionType.description: A recurring action, `pruning:<technique>` for pruning, or `customTask:<id>` for a custom task. Pruning and custom task values are listed on the added plant under `actions.pruning` and `actions.customTasks`.

204.description: Completed an action of the specified action type for the given plant id.

message.example: You are not authorized to make this request

415.description: Request body is not sent as application/json
